verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a log of tool calls passing through Pipedream MCP, and nothing covers per-call detail suitable for auditing or replaying agent actions. The only related item is a one-line marketing claim that "Conduit adds the security and observability IT teams need". It names no tool-call logging, audit trail or replay capability, so it is at most adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did
